Package net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.mixin

package net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.mixin
Applies the client-only FontRenderer hooks that share parsing decisions with width, trim and wrap.

The original Minecraft font remains responsible for its glyph textures and vanilla rendering. The mixin adds complete-token layout, scoped effect sampling and background/foreground passes. It is registered once by the standalone mod; consumers must not register a duplicate copy.
